svg.aria-label: The spec skill. Boxes: The preflight on main, then each premise of the step's text checked against the tree (a step of the session); Diagnosis agent, for a part that asks for a cause (agent, only when needed); A false premise the plan cannot absorb (stop); A rule clash with an ADR (stop); A cause not found (stop); Libraries looked for, as libraries: says (a step of the session); A user-visible choice (stop); The brief from templates/brief.md, its paths compared with the steps in flight (a step of the session); Brief-check agent, for a full step (agent, only when needed); A brief check finding the brief cannot absorb (stop); A model other than the configured one (stop); The preparation commit, the worktree at main's head, the base binaries staged, the dispatch entry filled (a step of the session); A step that does not converge (stop).
